Tracking the engineering transfer packet. When delivered, append the register link, class totals and blocker counts by failed condition to this issue's description; move this issue to In Validation. Keep validation issues unchanged. Final calls for this update are in the comments below; for the components they name, they take precedence over the register instructions.

---

## Transfer packet delivered (2026-02-14)

Register: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/19jqqbTGHxtOoJLVkylY5m-tlwVEo2HtI8eSMj8TYDvw/edit — saved in the "LLC transfer copy" folder (inside the handoff folder), reader access granted to arthur.blake@harmonygames.co.
Snapshot: 2026-02-12T18:00:00Z. Evidence review, not approval to ship. One row per included cohort component (SP-001..SP-128).

### Class totals
- READY: 44
- WATCH: 17
- HOLD: 67
- Total: 128

### Blocker counts by failed condition

SP-030, SP-044, SP-075, SP-088, SP-108, SP-114

## Owner calls
Per the final-calls comment on this issue; these take precedence over the register instructions for the named components.
SP-060, SP-116, SP-089, SP-111

- SP-007 — failed assertions: note 3 (on #551) vs register 0
